checks: Seven Laravel pages at six breakpoints: HTTP 200, decoded images/fonts, one h1/main, no duplicate IDs/Bootstrap, unique metadata, mobile menu/Escape/focus restoration and no overflow.
14 source-versus-Laravel full-page screenshot comparisons at desktop/mobile; no significant regression (<1% pixel threshold).
All nine practice modals, generated absolute image paths, Escape and focus restoration.
Professional filters/search/empty state and profile modal.
Insight modals, CSRF token, honest local-only forms/required/email/whitespace validation and accordion.
Values controls, reduced-motion, jsTree and generated sitemap route links.
Entire source and protected existing environment/composer/Vite/auth/database/scaffold hashes unchanged.
